note: Igris downloadable assets, fetched at runtime from EXPO_PUBLIC_ASSET_MANIFEST_URL so a new model never needs an app rebuild. v2 replaced the two loose Piper files with the sherpa-onnx bundle: sherpa needs tokens.txt and espeak-ng-data/ for phonemisation, which Piper's own .onnx.json does not provide. Repoint url at this repo's GitHub Release once assets-v1 is cut (PLAN.md decision #9).
